to burn from the idol. And it seemed to all of them as if the whole kitchen were ablaze. And when they carried water to
quench the fire, Benedict woke at their din and came over and told them that an illusory fire
was in their eyes, because he did not see the fire. Then he went to prayer and told the monks to make the sign of the cross
